implementation_policy: Reuse application-owned constitutive laws, censored-life inference and primary-data readers through strict MaterialJob schemas. Implement explicit support, exposure history, provenance and period semantics in this package.

method_selection.baseline: Preserve interpretable constitutive and time-fraction checks; deterministic indices do not supply event probabilities.
method_selection.censored_inference: Reuse the owner's censored lognormal model instead of regressing only observed failures or treating administrative endpoints as rupture. This model is not claimed to outperform all alternative lifetime families.
method_selection.remaining_comparison: Specimen-level held-out validation, alternative lifetime families, parameter uncertainty, multi-temperature identification, changing conditions and field transfer remain unqualified.

primary_method_references.title: NIST Engineering Statistics Handbook: lognormal lifetime distribution
primary_method_references.use: Distribution, median and survival relationships; original mathematical reference cases, no copied wording or tables.

primary_method_references.title: NIST Engineering Statistics Handbook: censored maximum-likelihood estimation example
primary_method_references.use: Censoring-aware estimation and comparison perspective; no source example data or code imported.
